name: Shiboritate Oppai Milk Café
original_name: 搾りたておっぱいみるくカフェ
source:
There are rumors of a specialty cafe that serves out-of-this-world delicious milk...

It's true! It's true! The milk comes from the oppai of a cute, big-breasted waitress.

She lets you drink her sweet titty milk! Yes!

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE095113.html]DLsite English[/url]]
translation:
据说有一家专门供应美味到超乎想象的乳汁咖啡馆……

竟然是真的！乳汁来自一名可爱、胸部丰满的女服务员。

她会让你喝下甜美的乳汁！没错！

[来源：[url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE095113.html]DLsite英文版[/url]]
